results.title: Substack Developer API – Substack, Inc
results.snippet: The Substack Developer API allows Substack users who have agreed to the API’s Terms of Use to retrieve public information on Substack profiles by querying a creator’s public LinkedIn handle. This API returns public profile data for verified Substack creators who have linked their LinkedIn accounts. In order to access Substack's Developer API you must create a Substack account, review the Substack Developer API’s Terms of Use, and submit your agreement to the Terms of Use via this form.
